title: Advanced Retrieval Strategies
subtitle: Reranking, hybrid search, and contextual retrieval

content.text: Basic vector search misses exact keyword matches. Hybrid search combines dense (vector) and sparse (keyword) retrieval for better results.

content.code:
from anthropic import Anthropic

# Step 1: Over-retrieve (top 20)
candidates = vector_store.search(query_embedding, top_k=20)

# Step 2: Rerank with a cross-encoder or via LLM
# Using Cohere rerank API as example
import cohere
co = cohere.Client("YOUR_KEY")
reranked = co.rerank(
    query=query,
    documents=[c.text for c in candidates],
    top_n=5

content.text: Always evaluate retrieval quality separately from generation quality. A bad retriever makes even the best LLM fail.

questions.question: What is the purpose of reranking?
options: To re-score retrieved documents using a more accurate model for better relevance ordering
questions.explanation: A reranker takes a large candidate set and re-scores them with a cross-encoder for more precise relevance ordering.

faq.a: Anthropic's technique of prepending a contextual description to each chunk before embedding, so the embedding captures both the chunk and its document-level context.
